page.notes: The printed "bcl" at the end of the Ætolorũ line is unclear; it is probably a misprint for "bellũ". "Actosia" is read from a long-s form and may stand for Ætolia. Entries at the left edge of the scan are cut off; the lines given are those fully visible. Doubtful readings are marked [?]: "alcronū" (possibly alcyonū), the Greek-derived "Ægypti" (the Æ ligature is hard to read), and the catchword. Long s is written as s throughout.
